headline: Six Fronts Surge as Bases Change Hands
war_summary: Since the last edition three hours ago the war’s tempo has quickened on a handful of sectors while others have eased. Weathered Expanse remains the bloodiest theatre: 24‑hour ownership flips rose to 55 from 42, Colonial losses climbed to 6,387 and Warden losses to 10,503, though fresh enlistments slipped to 329. Callahans Passage added thirteen new captures, lifting its daily total to 20; casualties now stand at 8,771 Colonial and 9,705 Warden dead with 641 new troops. Fisherman’s Row has become a fresh hotspot, recording 15 flips in the past day centred on Oceanwatch, Hangman’s Court and nearby posts, with modest casualties but a steady flow of 117 enlistees. Mooring County cooled, its flips halving to nine and casualties falling to 7,908 Colonial and 8,904 Warden, enlistments at 831. Palantine Berm likewise slipped to ten flips, each side suffering roughly 3,000 losses and 841 new recruits. Stlican Shelf held near its prior pace with nine flips, 2,276 Colonial and 2,427 Warden dead, and 367 enlistments. The remaining regions report no ownership changes, indicating the fighting is concentrated on these six fronts.
